releases.name: Dune Mechanic : Survive The Steampunk Era
CRYING BOOTH
releases.summary:
CRYING BOOTH is a compilation of five single player scenarios created by CRYING BOOTH. 

Game one through four are first person experiences with stealth, survival, and puzzle elements, while Game five is a side-scroller platformer.

releases.name: Boogie Bashers
releases.summary: Boogie Bashers lets you party like there’s no tomorrow. Dance in the spotlight and push others out of it in this goofy, 5 player party game. Steal power ups, avoid hazards, and outsmart your opponents to get more shine than everyone else.

releases.name: Color Fear
releases.summary:
This is a horror game unlike any other. Explore the deepest fears that come from The Color Fun Coloring Show.

Today on The Color Fun Coloring Show they want viewers to help them find out who is breaking into their house. Each new Fear that breaks in will hunt you down! All the show wants to know is what color they show you!

releases.name: Menhera & Troll
releases.summary: What if the keyboard warriors were actually beautiful girls? Become a psychology graduate student and try to heal their hearts. But don’t forget—they are Menhera and trolls! These girls are anything but ordinary.

releases.name: High Charisma
releases.summary: Charm your way to the top.You are a bard. Your boyfriend has been captured by Malachar the Lich and imprisoned at the summit of a  60-floor tower. Most heroes would grab a sword. You grabbed your lute.High Charisma is a first-person turn-based dungeon crawler where music is your weapon. Rather than cutting  down every creature in your path, use your instruments to charm spirit beasts and turn them into allies.  Build a party of former enemies, master new instruments, and ascend through crypts, frozen caverns, fire  pits, shadow halls, and storm-battered spires to rescue your hunk at the top.  Love is a Battlefield  Every enemy can become an ally. Use your charisma and instruments to befriend spirit beasts mid-combat and build your party from the creatures you encounter.  Music as a Weapon  Wield 12+ instruments like lutes, harps, fiddles, flutes, and accordions. Each instrument changes how you fight and how you charm.Grow Stronger  Level up, unlock feats, and gain abilities to become the bard the tower fears.Pixelated Dark Fantasy Fun  Hand-crafted 32x32 pixel sprites in a 3D dungeon environments. A retro aesthetic and an original soundtrack with 50+ tracks.

releases.name: Zoollision
releases.summary: Roll into Zoollision as adorable animal balls in 1v1 collision duels and chaotic 2-6 player races, unlock more animals and cosmetics, and build your own zoo-themed roster.

releases.name: Doomsday Legend
releases.summary: In 末日传奇, you play as an awakened survivor in a post-apocalyptic world. Navigate different factions, make key choices, and unlock multiple endings.

releases.name: Tower of Insolence
releases.summary: Grab your smithing hammer, pack your gear, and get ready to conquer the ominous Tower of Insolence in this cozy little puzzle game.

releases.name: Mini Slayer
releases.summary: A top-down arcade shooter where one mistake ends the run. Punch enemies for ammo, shoot them for power, and learn the waves well enough to reach the boss.

releases.name: Girls Summon
releases.summary: Girls Summon is a beautifully crafted idle card game where you collect and nurture characters.

releases.name: Jangan Tersesat
releases.summary: "Jangan Tersesat" is a single-location, puzzle-based psychological horror game you can complete in about 1-2 hours. Explore an old dormitory full of mystery, solve its secrets, evade what hunts you in the dark, and decide whether you will survive... or become part of its story.

releases.name: Ink Unfurls
releases.summary: Guide living ink across a quiet three-dimensional canvas. Choose where each new form grows, reshape the composition, and complete a small ink-wash artwork at your own pace.

releases.name: Tryshape
releases.summary: Talking Little HeroDescription Your cool friend is coming now. Talking Little Hero repeats everything you say with a funny voice. You can pet him, poke him. Enjoy hours of fun and laughter with Talking Lovely Hero.He is especially fun for children of all ages. Play with Lovely Hero: - Talk to Lovely Hero and He will repeat everything you say with a funny voice. - He is too shy to let people see him. - He can read with a cool machine. - Throw him to coke. - He also can eat apple. Enjoy Your Little Hero
